set.body:
Goal: let a plot name its axes and carry a title. Today you cannot label an axis.

Evidence: GuideSpec.Axis (Layout.scala:138-149) has no title field — tick labels exist, axis names do not; grep finds no plot-title/subtitle/axis-label concept anywhere in the module. Every default plot floats on a blank field with unnamed axes, the single most visible gap.

Acceptance: axis title on GuideSpec.Axis (from the scale name by default, overridable), placed and sized by the layout solver via TextMetrics; a PlotSpec-level title and optional subtitle laid out above the panel; labels flow through the compiler, not per-backend; conformance gains a titled-plot case; JVM+JS tests. Coordinate with the theme issue (theme owns title styling; this issue owns structure/layout).
set.title: Graphics: axis titles and plot title/subtitle/labels
